Seq2seq resolved to exactly its two consumed components: the cell (LSTM 1997 - both encoder and decoder are built from it) and the decoder formulation (Mikolov's RNNLM 2010 - the paper defines its decoder as an RNNLM conditioned on the input). The sharpest coeval artifact so far: Cho et al.'s RNN Encoder-Decoder (arXiv June 2014 vs seq2seq September 2014), the single most direct predecessor, dropped at the year bound together with 8 other 2014 artifacts (Devlin NNJM, GRU, Neural Turing Machines, Memory Networks, the WMT'14 dataset itself, dropout, conditional VAE, Chandar et al.) - at year granularity the template seq2seq scaled is unrepresentable as its predecessor. Recipe components behaved as designed: gradient clipping and teacher forcing passed directness (both literally in the paper's training procedure) but failed the Q1/Q2 gate on honest partials - components of a leap, not leaps. Generic substrate rejected as such: backpropagation, BPTT, SGD, CUDA. Two existing nodes (Bidirectional RNNs, Graves soft window) were scouted and matched but rejected for this parent - Sutskever's encoder is a unidirectional LSTM over reversed input, so no false convergence edges; both remain correctly attached at Bahdanau. NPLM rejected as mediated via the RNNLM, its consumed descendant.

BRNN resolved to its single consumed component: the Elman network (1990), the 'regular recurrent neural network' the paper explicitly extends in two directions. One-survivor expansion, like GPT-2's. Coeval artifact: LSTM (1997) dropped at the year bound - BRNN and LSTM are same-year siblings and their famous combination (BLSTM) waited until 2005, so at year granularity the cell BRNN would later marry is unrepresentable at this level. The forward-backward algorithm was graded directness=partial - the two-pass template is structurally identical to HMM smoothing and the authors worked in that tradition, but the paper presents the construction architecturally without citing it; partial fails the gate honestly rather than forcing a verdict. The Elman advance arrived twice in scouting (as 'Elman recurrent network' and as 'Finding structure in time', its own paper title); the second was filed as mediated via the first so the graph keeps exactly one Elman node. TDNN rejected as the overcome prior state (the paper defines itself against the preset future frame); substrate discipline maintained (BPTT/backprop/SGD/Fourier rejected as generic machinery).
